description.text: The modification pack (改造包) came in the Happy Set Pikachu & Clefairy & Turtwig & Gimmighoul of 17 January 2025. Its ten cards are for a player who lost a game to add to their deck before the next. It holds two of six Pokémon, three of six Supporters, three of six Items and two of five Pokémon Tools, never the same card twice. One of the Pokémon, Cyclizar ex, turns up 3.1% of the time; the other five Pokémon are made in equal numbers, and so are the cards within each of the other kinds. In a two-player game the loser of the first game picks up to four of its cards and the loser of the second up to six of those left; in four-player games the two losers toss a coin and take turns picking.
